svg.title: Tokens per command, by scenario
svg.desc: Estimated tokens per command on a log scale for 23 scenarios in 3 suites. Native totals 269,736 tokens and 46/46 facts; RTK totals 236,535 tokens and 44/46 facts; JevTO totals 16,979 tokens and 45/46 facts. Hollow dots with a red cross missed a required fact; double rings were not routed by RTK.
